_comment: Common confusions shown on word pages. Drawn from the notes in vocabulario.html; extend by hand.

confusions.explanation: Suceso means an event or incident; success is éxito.
Desierto is a desert; dessert is postre.
Ambicioso means ambitious; ambiguous is ambiguo.
Resumir means to summarize; to resume (start again) is reanudar.
Decepcionado means disappointed; deceived is engañado.
Asombrado means amazed; ashamed is avergonzado.
Premio is a prize or reward; price is precio.
Habilidad is a skill or ability; a habit is un hábito.
Harina is flour; a flower is una flor.
Pantalla is a screen; trousers are pantalones.
Soledad is solitude or loneliness; solidarity is solidaridad.
Envidioso means envious of what others have; celoso means jealous, especially in love.
Confiado means trusting, sometimes overconfident; self-confident is seguro de sí mismo.
Ilusionado means excited or hopeful, not disillusioned (desilusionado).
Pelear means to fight; to argue is discutir.
Despedir means to fire or dismiss someone; despedirse means to say goodbye.
Comprobar means to check or verify; to prove is demostrar.
Fijar means to fix in place or set (a date); to repair is arreglar.
Aprobar means to pass an exam; suspender means to fail it (in Spain).
Fecha is a calendar date; a date with someone is una cita.
Sabiduría is wisdom; knowledge is el conocimiento.
Nieve is snow; a niece is una sobrina.
Guardar means to save a file or keep something; to save money is ahorrar.
